verdict: Leads steady over 28 days; cost per lead rising in the most recent week.
narrative: You received 175 leads over the last 28 days at an average cost of $12.15 per lead, with all paid activity running through a single Meta campaign. In the most recent 7 days, lead volume fell 15.9% and cost per lead rose 18% week-over-week — a pattern consistent with creative wear-out on a campaign that has been running without rotation. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to relieve that pressure and bring cost per lead back toward the $9–$11 range seen earlier this summer. Separately, 148 contacts reached your pipeline over the period but zero were logged as active opportunities, which points to an intake gap rather than an ads problem — that process is being addressed directly. Organic visibility through your Google Business Profile also softened this week, and a posting cadence is being reinstated to stabilize that signal.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days
average cost per lead this period, up from a ~$9–$11 low in July
organic actions on your Google Business Profile this period (calls, directions, website clicks)

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead climbed 18% in the last 7 days as the sole active campaign shows signs of audience fatigue.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being rotated this week, and a retargeting audience is being activated to broaden reach and reduce reliance on a single ad set.
